description: Public programme, flyers and materials from the Andes Virus Workshop held on November 5, 2026, in Puerto Varas, Chile.

data.title: ANDV Workshop
data.lede: The Andes Virus Workshop brought together researchers, clinicians and public health professionals at Hotel Bellavista in Puerto Varas, Chile, with virtual participation and simultaneous English–Spanish translation.

data.heading: Andes virus: research & public health.
paragraphs: Thursday, November 5, 2026 · 08:00–16:30 · Hotel Bellavista, Puerto Varas, Chile.

Organized by Marcela Ferrés, Nicole Le Corre and Nicole D. Tischler, the workshop addressed reservoirs and public health, patients and hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, and prevention, follow-up and public education.
The detailed workshop programme is public. Presentation slides and the recording will be added when released by the organizers.
